verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI documents its own speech-understanding layer on top of transcripts: summarization, sentiment, and topic detection for extracting structured insight. It also offers an LLM Gateway that applies frontier reasoning models to transcripts, for example to generate structured meeting notes, so AI-generated insights from the user's audio data are a first-party capability. These are delivered via the API rather than a dashboard experience, and evidence is docs-only. missing for 10: evidence of in-product (UI/Playground) insight surfacing, explicit actionable suggestions beyond summaries and analysis, independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
